exact_reads.post_freeze_accounting_reads: Only own tool-result.ts and author-record.json will be read to report final SHA-256/bytes/lines; output file and directory modes will be inspected. These prospective final accounting reads are explicitly distinguished from the completed reads above.
exact_reads.metadata_access_scope: Assigned output directory creation and own file/directory mode accounting only.
exact_reads.execution_tools: Two scoped Python scripts through exec_command: six authorized input reads; own output write/read/hash/mode/time accounting. No repository traversal or discovery.

chosen_structure.description: Nine exported functions in public API order, with one private isRecord predicate adjacent to error classification. Branches remain direct to retain repeated live property observations and native short-circuit order.

retained_expression.qualification: Required API, schema, protocol strings, constants, and ordinary expressions are retained to satisfy the contract. No novelty, originality, provenance beyond these inputs, or license/rights grant is claimed.
retained_expression.literal_data: Import paths, object/string/boolean type tags, empty strings, Bash, mcp__, __, and zero numeric literals retained exactly where required; no regex introduced.
retained_expression.external_constants_qualification: These frozen data values are accounted for here only. None is used by the nine-function contract, so no extra source constants, imports, features, or exports are introduced.
retained_expression.prose_qualification: Frozen contract/declaration/data qualifications remain authoritative. No implementation prose requirement was identified beyond retaining semantics and required literal data.

manual_contract_assessment.method: Static manual reasoning from exactly six authorized inputs and the authored text; no compiler, execution, mocks, tests, lint, build, dependency inspection, or runtime claim.
manual_contract_assessment.emptyTokenUsageInfo: Fresh object with own input/output/reasoning zero and fresh cache read/write zero. No total own field. ReturnType signature retained.
manual_contract_assessment.toTokenUsageInfo: Own total included even when undefined. Reads total,input,output,reasoning,cacheRead,cacheWrite in prescribed order. Nullish zero defaults preserve negative and other non-nullish values. No derived total; fresh nested cache.
manual_contract_assessment.toRecordInput: Truthy nonarray objects, including nonplain instances, return the same reference with a type cast. All other inputs return a fresh object with own value, including undefined.
manual_contract_assessment.stringifyToolResultOutput: Present modelContent reread for type, then reread for return or opaque delegate; null/nonstring native delegate behavior untouched. Failure and error message short-circuit before output. Output reread for type/return/undefined/JSON in prescribed branches. JSON and getter/delegate failures propagate without catch.
manual_contract_assessment.modelContentForToolResult: Present modelContent reread and returned unchanged by identity; otherwise own stringifyToolResultOutput called.
manual_contract_assessment.isErrorForToolResult: Failure returns true before output observation. Private record check uses typeof object, nonnull, nonarray. Explicit camel/snake nullish reads retained; boolean false returned and nonboolean camel blocks snake lookup. Bash and interrupted boolean guard precedes opaque provider call; true provider result returns true, otherwise interrupted is reread. No general classifier or text heuristics.
manual_contract_assessment.stringifyForEstimation: JSON serialization and first String fallback stay inside try. Catch invokes String again, whose failure escapes; native toJSON/cycle/BigInt/conversion behavior preserved.
manual_contract_assessment.parseMcpToolName: Exact prefix check and split/destructure; missing server or zero tool parts rejected. Empty final tool part accepted; remaining separators preserved in join; fresh returned object.
manual_contract_assessment.findParallelGroupIndex: Direct native findIndex/includes delegation on original receivers, preserving native ordering, holes, result index/-1, and exceptions.
manual_contract_assessment.api_imports_identity: Exactly nine function exports, original imports retained. No dependency implementation, reexports, alternate authority, copies of delegate inputs, or invented collaborator.
manual_contract_assessment.source_size: Authored source is below the 400-line limit.
manual_contract_assessment.limitations: No compilation or runtime validation was performed or claimed; fragments retain original owner authority and are not asserted standalone compilation units.

restrictions.content_scope: Only six named frozen input files and own output content.

restrictions.shared_executor: Instruction-only restriction; no OS isolation, access audit proof, separate executor guarantee, or denial of preexisting broader context is claimed.
restrictions.curator_and_prior_context: A source-exposed curator and prior broader context are qualified as such, not treated as body-unexposed independent provenance or a proof of isolation. This author did not read curator material, predecessor source, other-author source, or dependency bodies during this task.
restrictions.own_output_permissions: 0444 files and 0555 assigned output directory before curator body review.

freeze.timestamp_semantics: UTC sampled immediately before receipt serialization and requested chmod operations; final modes verified and reported separately after freezing.
freeze.review_order: Freeze both files and assigned output directory before handing source to curator body review.
freeze.self_hash: Receipt does not embed its own hash; its final exact hash/bytes/lines are reported externally after freezing.
